neighbours.label: EU integration and regional-policy context (Member States, cohesion and structural funds, eastern enlargement, the Commission): fires on function tokens inside such prose
fire: Since enlargement, the poorer Member States have drawn heavily on cohesion funds to build roads and rail.
The Commission's regional policy channels structural funds to lagging regions through multi-annual programmes.
Convergence between the old and the new Member States slowed after the financial crisis.
Under the common agricultural policy, direct payments to farmers in eastern Europe were phased in over ten years.
The Court of Auditors found that rural development grants in the newer members were poorly monitored.
Freedom of movement let workers from the accession countries take jobs in the older industrial regions.
Brussels tied the recovery money to reforms in the member countries' judicial systems.
Along the eastern border, cross-border cooperation programmes paid for bridges and customs posts.
quiet: Since statehood, the poorer counties have drawn heavily on federal highway money to build roads and rail.
The governor's regional policy channels state funds to lagging districts through five-year plans.
Convergence between the coastal and the inland provinces of China slowed after the financial crisis.
Under the farm bill, direct payments to growers in the Midwest were phased in over ten years.
The auditor general found that rural development grants in the northern territories were poorly monitored.
Internal migration let workers from the hill districts take jobs in the older industrial cities.
Delhi tied the relief money to reforms in the states' police systems.
Along the southern border, the two neighbouring provinces paid for bridges and customs posts.
